intentions.title: Drive the entire CLI (dispatch, help, completion, URL building) as a pure function of the server's GET /v1/capabilities manifest, with zero hardcoded nouns/verbs/flags/routes
intentions.evidence: manifest.go package doc: 'The package hardcodes NO noun, verb, flag, or route... a future plugin adds commands with zero code change here.' tree.go builds Tree purely from m.Nouns/m.Commands; Command struct mirrors docs/cli/manifest.schema.json field-for-field.

intentions.title: Let a plugin extend the CLI surface (new nouns/commands) with zero code changes in the manifest package
intentions.evidence: tree.go: Tree() synthesizes a node for any command whose noun wasn't declared in m.Nouns rather than dropping it ('the manifest is the sole source of truth, and dropping such a command would silently hide a capability'); Noun.Plugin and Command.Source fields track plugin provenance.

intentions.title: Minimize repeated manifest fetches via ETag-validated on-disk caching without ever risking a stale/incorrect command set
intentions.evidence: cache.go: sha256-keyed cache files, atomic temp-file+rename writes to prevent torn reads; fetch.go: Fetch() sends If-None-Match, on 304 returns cached body, on 200 reparses and refreshes cache; cache write failures are swallowed ('an optimisation, never a correctness dependency').

intentions.title: Keep per-tenant/per-token manifests correctly isolated in cache (admin vs anon capability sets never collide) while never persisting raw tokens to disk
intentions.evidence: cache.go CacheKey(): hashes token to an 8-byte salt ('anon' bucket for empty token) combined with base URL — 'an admin manifest and an anon manifest differ... the token itself never appears in the key or the filename.'

intentions.title: Resolve CLI target context (server/token/workspace/project/dataset/output) via one deterministic precedence: flags > env > active context > defaults, in advance of a real on-disk context store
intentions.evidence: context.go Resolve() and its `pick` helper; ActiveContext documented as a 'clean seam' for future `barkpark context use <name>` persistence; DefaultDefaults() bakes in dataset=production, output=table per M0 decision A2.

intentions.title: Prevent CLI requests from ever silently hitting the wrong or a malformed path — fail loudly on unresolved placeholders, and keep the workspace/project scoped-prefix mirror inert until a server actually advertises it
intentions.evidence: url.go fillTemplate(): 'A placeholder with no resolvable value is an error — better to fail loudly than to send a request to a path with an empty segment'; BuildURL only prepends ScopedPrefix when ctx.ScopedMirror is true, documented as inert in v1 to avoid turning a flat path into a 404/403 ('contract spine rule #4'); resolvePlaceholder lets an explicit positional arg override ambient ctx scope (documented onixedit.export dataset-per-call fix).

intentions.title: Make manifest parsing strict and self-verifying so a malformed, truncated, or doubled server response is caught at decode time instead of propagating a corrupt CLI command tree
intentions.evidence: manifest.go Parse(): DisallowUnknownFields(), requires manifest_version, and explicitly rejects trailing data after the first JSON value ('a doubled body, a truncated-then-retried response... must fail loud rather than be silently dropped').
